text:
lena: quickstart docker image failing for me — local node sample works but the container errors with "Tenant not authorized" and shows a vague UI failure. no link to billing.

samira: can you paste the error body? is it from SDK or gateway?

lena: here it is:
```json
{
  "error": "Tenant not authorized",
  "code": "tenant_blocked",
  "details": null
}
```
mike: tenant_blocked is used for a few cases. does the same workspace work when you call hosted API from your laptop?

lena: yes — curl against hosted API succeeds. only containerized quickstart fails.

ops_jay: likely env var issue. Docker quickstart requires REDWOOD_ORG (or WORKSPACE_ID) to route correctly. if unset it falls back to anonymous routing and the gateway rejects with tenant_blocked (anonymous tenant needs billing). check `docker logs` or env at container start.

lena: confirmed — container entrypoint didn't pick up my .env by default so REDWOOD_ORG was empty. with REDWOOD_ORG set the quickstart works.

devex: two suggested fixes: 1) SDK should give a clearer hint when tenant_blocked is returned and no org header was present. 2) quickstart entrypoint should warn at startup if REDWOOD_ORG is missing and link to workspace billing settings.

samira: i'll add SDK behavior: when we detect tenant_blocked and missing org header, return: "Request blocked: workspace requires billing setup. Ensure REDWOOD_ORG or X-Redwood-Org is set. See https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/<workspace-id>/billing". also add a unit test simulating missing header.

mike: i'll add a shell check in the quickstart image entrypoint:
```bash
if [ -z "$REDWOOD_ORG" ]; then
  echo "⚠️ REDWOOD_ORG not set. Quickstart will route to an anonymous workspace which may be billing-locked. See https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces"
fi
```

ops_jay: i'll open a tiny PR to quickstart repo for the startup warning and README note. samira — you take the SDK error text change?

samira: on it.

billing-bot: Notice: workspace wz-9c2 requires billing contact. Admins visit https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/wz-9c2/billing to add payment/contact info.

lena: thanks — after setting REDWOOD_ORG the container works. reassigning to devex for follow-ups on docs and PRs. 🙂

devex: filed tasks quickstart-env-warning and sdk-tenant-block-hint, will link PRs and add a short onboarding blurb to the welcome email explaining why firstcall might be blocked.

mike: low-risk fixes, good DX improvement. :thumbsup:
